text:
harper: Tiny thread: neon-synth rainy evening recs + one short novella (<=180p). thinking M83 / synth-heavy stuff or something more cinematic. quickfire answers pls. :neon:

dmitri: M83 Hurry Up, Were Dreaming (pick quieter tracks like Intro) + "The Lover" by Marguerite Duras. dreamy & dense. :sparkler:

anya: Suggest Destroyer Kaputt for late-night lounge synths + "The Strange Library" (Murakami) for a bizarre quick read. :owl:

harper: solid. anyone do short film recs to pair with synthy sets?
dmitri: La Jetée is perfect (short, photo-film). pairs weirdly well.

anya: also: Julianna Barwick ambient vocal loops (good for background) + "Bartleby, the Scrivener" if you want curt & uncanny. :ghost:

harper: ops-bot, can you make a 30-min sample playlist "neon-rain-30" combining M83, Destroyer, Barwick, and one odd track by Angelo Badalamenti? include one instrumental track minimum.

ops-bot: Created playlist "neon-rain-30" (8 tracks, ~31m). Link: https://play.example/pl/neonrain30. Expires in 7 days.

dmitri: vote: novella pick: Duras (dmitri), Murakami (anya). harper: tie-breaker? :thinking:

harper: tie-breaker: whoever brings weird snacks to tonight's listening gets to pick the film. stakes. :cookie:

anya: i'll bring salted licorice and tea. (sorry not sorry).
dmitri: i will bring espresso & dark chocolate. deal.
harper: perfect. meetup: kitchen alcove, 8pm. warm lights, low volume, La Jetée queued if snacks decide. :film_projector:

anya: also pro tip: read the novella during the credits break, fits the vibe.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "neon-rain listening" at 8:00 PM today in #random (auto-reminder 30 minutes prior).

harper: thanks everyone. see you at 8. :headphones:
